reason: The frozen training-history deletions do not depend on main-candidate ranking. A second independent training process was started while the main process was running to use available GPU capacity.
separation: Each process owns its random state, model, optimizer, CUDA context, predictions, curves, manifest and checkpoint directory. Protocol, models, source hashes, masks, targets, training budgets and selection rules were not modified.
timing_interpretation: Reported phase elapsed times overlap and must not be summed as total wall-clock duration.
verification: All prior evidence is hashed separately by each phase; every saved checkpoint is replayed. All full-history baseline predictions must match round 5.
